verdict.rationale: Instinct exposes no API or developer surface for minting scoped credentials. Least privilege is only approximated: users choose which credentials go into the Vault, can revoke Google access, and in one reviewer's case added an external spend-limited card or, in another user's case, a separate Google account. The Google Workspace link grants broad access across Gmail, Drive, Calendar and other services with no documented scoping, and one user reported the permission model got in the way of credential use. Missing for 10: first-party scoped/least-privilege credential issuance, per-service permission scopes, expiry or audit controls, and documentation of any such feature.
